twilioIntegration.exposureWarning: Turning this on opens a separate local port that your tunnel publishes to the internet. Only requests signed with your Twilio Auth Token are accepted; the rest of VoiceStudio stays private.
twilioIntegration.authTokenHint: Stored encrypted on this computer. Never shown again or exported.
twilioIntegration.publicUrlHint: Paste the https address {{tool}} prints, for example the one ending in .trycloudflare.com or .ngrok-free.app.
twilioIntegration.greetingPlaceholder: Thanks for calling. We will get back to you soon.
twilioIntegration.testHint: Hear your greeting as a caller will (8 kHz μ-law). Nothing leaves this computer.
twilioIntegration.tunnelHint: Forward your tunnel to this local address only, never to VoiceStudio's main port.
twilioIntegration.stepAccountHint: Copy your Account SID and Auth Token from the Twilio Console home page.
twilioIntegration.checkHint: Checks the format here. Twilio confirms the token when it signs your first call.
twilioIntegration.authTokenStored: Saved on this computer. It is never shown again or exported.
twilioIntegration.stepTunnelHint: Twilio must reach this computer over https. A tunnel gives it a public address that forwards to VoiceStudio's call gateway.
twilioIntegration.listenerFailed: Calls are on, but the gateway is not listening. Turn calls off and on again, or check Logs.
twilioIntegration.listenerOffHint: The gateway starts when you turn on calls. Your tunnel can run before that.
twilioIntegration.checkPrompt: Check whether the call gateway is listening.
twilioIntegration.stepNumberHint: Point your Twilio number's incoming calls at VoiceStudio.
twilioIntegration.phoneNumberInvalid: Use international format: + and country code, then the number, digits only.
twilioIntegration.consoleOpen: In the Twilio Console, open Phone Numbers → Manage → Active numbers and choose your number.
twilioIntegration.consoleVoice: Under Voice Configuration, set "A call comes in" to Webhook with HTTP POST.
twilioIntegration.consolePaste: Paste the URL above and save. This step shows Done once a call passes Twilio's signature check.
twilioIntegration.webhookNeedsTunnel: Save your public tunnel URL in step 2 to get the webhook URL.
twilioIntegration.stepVoiceHint: Choose how VoiceStudio sounds and what callers hear.
twilioIntegration.modeAgentSoon: The AI agent comes with Calls. For now VoiceStudio plays your greeting and hangs up.
twilioIntegration.disclosureDefault: This call uses an AI-generated voice.
twilioIntegration.disclosureNote: Some places require telling callers they hear an AI voice, or getting their consent to record. Check the rules where you and your callers are.
twilioIntegration.error_invalid_account_sid: The Account SID starts with AC followed by 32 letters and digits.
twilioIntegration.error_invalid_public_url: Use the https address your tunnel printed, for example https://example.trycloudflare.com, with no path.
twilioIntegration.error_listener_failed: The call gateway could not start. Another app may be using its port; see Logs.
twilioIntegration.previewNeedsGreeting: Write a greeting in step 4 to preview it.
twilioIntegration.callMeSoon: Test calls to your own phone come with Calls.
twilioIntegration.securitySigned: Every webhook must carry a valid Twilio signature made with your Auth Token. Unsigned requests are rejected.
twilioIntegration.securityTokens: Each call gets a single-use, short-lived token for its audio stream.
twilioIntegration.securityIsolation: The gateway is a separate local port that serves only call routes. The rest of VoiceStudio stays private.
twilioIntegration.securitySecret: Your Auth Token is stored encrypted on this computer and never shown, logged or exported.
twilioIntegration.voiceCallHint: Voices marked "Can call" are your verified own voice or a designed voice. Only those can place calls.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.desc: VoiceStudio runs entirely on your device — these OS permissions are used only for the features listed here, and audio never leaves your machine.
permissions.microphone_why: Used for dictation and voice recording. Audio is processed locally.
permissions.accessibility_why: Lets dictation paste or type the transcript into other apps.
permissions.web_note: OS permission status is only readable in the desktop app — in the browser, microphone access is managed by the browser itself.

pronunciation.title: Pronunciation dictionary
pronunciation.help: Teach the engine how to say tricky words. Each entry replaces a word with a respelling before synthesis, so it applies on every engine. Scope an entry to one language or leave it Global. Inline, [[word|respelling]] overrides the dictionary once.
pronunciation.empty: No entries yet. Add one below to fix a mispronounced word.
pronunciation.test_placeholder: Type a sentence to preview the substitution…
pronunciation.test_nochange: No entries match — spoken as written.
pronunciation.lang_label: Language code (e.g. en, de) or leave blank for Global
pronunciation.test_global_hint: Previewing Global entries only — pick a language to include language-scoped entries.
pronunciation.test_error: Preview unavailable — couldn't reach the backend.
pronunciation.backup_hint: Download the dictionary as a JSON file, or import entries from a previous export.
pronunciation.import_replace_prompt: Replace the {{count}} existing entries with the imported file? Choose No to add the imported entries alongside them.
pronunciation.import_error: Couldn't import that file — expected JSON from a pronunciation export.

app.name: VoiceStudio
app.tagline: Open source voice cloning and workflow engine. Build local.

backend.port_in_use: Port {{port}} is already in use by another program. Close it, or set OMNIVOICE_PORT to a free port, then retry.
backend.failed: The local engine could not start.
backend.first_run_hint: First run can take several minutes while the Python environment is prepared.
backend.setup_hint: Download Python and app dependencies (several GB). Voice models are installed separately when you choose them.
backend.setup_space: Free at least 9 GiB on the app’s drive, then retry.
backend.setup_access: Allow write access to the app’s data folder, then retry.
backend.proxy_bypass_help: Fully quit VoiceStudio, set HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY to your proxy URL and NO_PROXY to excluded hosts in a terminal, then launch VoiceStudio from that terminal. Retrying in the current app cannot load new environment variables.

engines.none_ready_body: VoiceStudio can automatically set up the best compatible option for this device.
engines.localInstallRequired: Install this engine on the backend computer using localhost or its setup guide. Remote installation is disabled.
engines.argosRuntimeUnavailable: Argos runtime unavailable. Reinstall the backend or select NLLB.

clone.title: Voice cloning
clone.paste_failed: Clipboard access was blocked. Paste directly into the text field using your keyboard.
clone.ref_usage_best_window: This engine uses up to {{seconds}}s — the best passage is picked automatically.
clone.ref_usage_head: This engine uses the first {{seconds}}s of this clip.
clone.ref_usage_long: Longer than the recommended {{seconds}}s. The whole clip is sent to the engine.
clone.drop_audio: Drop audio here — or click. WAV, MP3, M4A…
clone.unsupported_audio: Choose a supported audio file: WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC, OGG, AAC, or WebM.
clone.transcript_hint: What the reference clip says. Leave empty to let the engine listen.
clone.save_failed: Could not save the voice profile: {{message}}
clone.no_profiles: No saved voices yet. Upload or record a reference, then save it as a profile.
clone.output_empty: Your generated audio will appear here.
clone.history_clear_confirm: Delete every take from history? Audio files are removed too.
clone.seed_reroll_hint: Roll a new random seed and keep it
clone.design_placeholder: Describe the voice, then type what it says…
clone.describe_placeholder: e.g. a warm elderly British storyteller, slightly raspy
clone.describe_hint: Describe the voice, or pick a starting point. Either one fills in the details below.
clone.describe_no_match: No voice traits recognized yet — try words like deep, elderly, or British.
clone.vd_exclusive_cleared: Cleared {{cleared}} — a Chinese dialect and an English accent can't be combined.
clone.accent_dialect_hint: one or the other, never both
clone.replace_reference_hint: Saving replaces this voice's reference sample. Its locked take and own-voice verification are cleared because the new clip may be a different speaker. Leave the transcript blank to transcribe the new clip automatically.

recording.mic_denied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in your system privacy settings and try again.
recording.mic_busy: The microphone is in use by another application.
recording.recorder_unsupported: This system cannot encode microphone audio.

tts_errors.profile_language_rejected: Auto uses the voice profile’s language ({{language}}), which this engine does not support. Change the profile language, choose a supported language, or switch engines.
tts_errors.upload_or_select: Upload a reference clip or pick a saved voice.
tts_errors.too_long: The clip is {{duration}}s. The engine accepts at most {{max}}s without a transcript.
tts_errors.timeout: Generation timed out — the model may still be downloading. Try again in a moment.
tts_errors.generation_in_progress: A generation is already running — wait for it to finish before starting another.
tts_errors.ignored_conflict: Ignored {{items}} — a Chinese dialect and an English accent can't be combined.
tts_errors.model_not_downloaded: The model is not downloaded yet. Open the main app's Settings → Engines to install it.
tts_errors.backend_unreachable: The local engine is not reachable.
tts_errors.gpu_arch_unsupported: This PyTorch build does not support your GPU. Choose CPU in Settings → Performance & Device, or install a compatible PyTorch build.
tts_errors.windows_app_control_blocked: Windows application control blocked a required file. Ask your administrator to allow the trusted VoiceStudio runtime, then restart the app.
tts_errors.audio_io_failed: Audio could not be read or saved. Check the file format, free disk space, and file permissions. Review the folder in Settings → Storage.
tts_errors.no_audio_track: This file has no audio track, so there is no speech to transcribe, dub or clone. Choose a video or audio file that contains sound.

tts.routingFallback: Running on CPU — this engine has no GPU path on your machine, so generation will be slower. {{reason}}
tts.droppedChunks_one: Heads up: {{count}} part of your text produced no audio, so this take is missing it. Try re-generating.
tts.droppedChunks_other: Heads up: {{count}} parts of your text produced no audio, so this take is missing them. Try re-generating.
tts.droppedChunksWithText_one: Heads up: {{count}} part of your text produced no audio — “{{text}}”. Try re-generating.
tts.droppedChunksWithText_other: Heads up: {{count}} parts of your text produced no audio — “{{text}}”. Try re-generating.

preferences.autoplay_preview_label: Play the output as soon as a render finishes

profileIdentity.save_hint: Save this voice to use it again in one click.
profileIdentity.search_unavailable: Image search needs a configured search provider. Upload an image instead.
profileIdentity.search_empty: No images found. Try another name or upload an image.
profileIdentity.generation_failed: Audio could not be created. Your script is still here; try again.

modelMaintenance.deleteConfirm: Delete {{repoId}}? You can reinstall it later.
modelMaintenance.reinstallConfirm: Reinstall {{repoId}}? This will delete the current copy and download again.
modelMaintenance.inMemoryDescription: Loaded in memory now — unloading frees RAM/VRAM and it reloads on next use
modelMaintenance.gatedAccessRequired: Hugging Face access is required before this model can be installed.
modelMaintenance.gatedAccessReady: Access is ready. This model can now be installed.
modelMaintenance.gatedAccessStillRequired: Access or a token is still missing. Complete the steps, then check again.

transcriptions.mode_fast_desc: Uses the selected low-latency dictation model.
transcriptions.mode_accurate_desc: Uses the selected ASR model with detailed timestamps.
transcriptions.title: Transcriptions
transcriptions.empty_desc: Select Start dictation or press {{shortcut}} to record and transcribe audio.
transcriptions.capture_failed: Could not start dictation. Check microphone access, then try again.
transcriptions.missing_model: No speech-to-text model is installed — this feature needs one to transcribe audio.

dub.install_popover_frozen_body: This packaged build can't install engines — its Python environment is read-only and signed. Run the command below in a from-source install, or switch to the bundled Argos engine.
dub.batch_queue_link: Dubbing many videos? Open the batch queue
dub.cookie_transport_error: Cookie exports require HTTPS or the local desktop app.
dub.cookie_size_error: The cookie export must be 1 MB or smaller.
dub.speaker: Speaker {{n}}:
dub.dialect_title: Regional dialect and vocabulary for the translation (e.g. Argentina → "vos sos" instead of "tú eres"). Applied by LLM engines (OpenAI/Ollama) and Cinematic quality.
dub.num_speakers_help: How many speakers are in this video? Leave blank to auto-detect. Set a number if auto-detect merges multiple speakers into one.
dub.prep_demucs_note: Demucs can take several minutes on long videos. Long audio = longer wait.
dub.supported_formats: MP4 · MOV · MKV · WEBM · MP3 · WAV · FLAC · M4A
dub.pull_captions_title: When the URL is a caption-bearing host (YouTube, Vimeo, TED…), also pull the original captions and any YouTube auto-translations. Seeds the editor without running Whisper; skip Translate All for languages YouTube already covers.
dub.first_play_hint: first play may take a moment to mux
dub.cast_title: Assign a voice to each detected speaker. Cross-lingual clones keep the same speaker identity in a new language.
dub.casting_board_hint: Open the casting board — drag a voice onto a speaker
dub.casting_drag_hint: Drag a voice chip onto a speaker, or press Enter on a speaker to pick from a list.
dub.quality_title: Cinematic = 3-step LLM refinement (translate → reflect → adapt). Needs an LLM configured.
dub.auto_glossary_title: One extra LLM pass reads the whole transcript and extracts the video's theme plus key terms, so names and terminology stay consistent across segments. Your manual glossary entries always win.
dub.reflect_title: After each segment's direct translation, the LLM critiques and rewrites it into natural spoken dialogue. Uses 3 LLM calls per segment instead of 1; if refinement fails, the direct translation is kept.
dub.condense_title: When a translated line is predicted not to fit its time slot, ask the LLM for a shorter meaning-preserving rewrite you can apply per segment. Off by default; needs a configured LLM.
dub.restore_title: Restore all segments to the original transcribed text
dub.clean_up_title: Merge tiny fragments and adjacent short segments
dub.install_disabled_title: Installs are disabled in packaged builds
dub.glossary_title: Pin translations for recurring terms (names, brand words, jargon)
dub.dual_subs_title: Export subtitles with translated text on top and original italicised underneath.
dub.burn_subs_title: Render subtitles directly into the MP4 video stream (hardsubs). Uses the dual-subtitle format when Dual subtitles is on.
dub.timing_smart_fit_title: Splits the difference: slightly speeds up the audio (pitch preserved, up to 1.5×) and slightly slows down that segment of the video (up to 2×) so natural-rate speech fits. Anything beyond the caps is trimmed and flagged. Export re-encodes the video.
dub.voice_match_title: Voice match — whether each dubbed line clones from its own source clip or every line of a speaker shares one reference.
dub.voice_match_per_line_title: Each line clones from a clip of its own source audio. Best per-line prosody match, but the voice identity can drift from line to line.
dub.voice_match_consistent_title: Every line of a speaker clones from one shared reference (the speaker clone, or the best single clip when none exists). Steadier voice identity across the whole dub.
dub.qc_result: {{flagged}} of {{total}} lines may need a re-listen
dub.install_restart: {{engine}} installed. Restart the backend to load it.
dub.cinematic_needs_llm_hint: Cinematic needs an LLM. Configure one in Settings → Credentials → LLM endpoint (Ollama runs locally, no key needed).
dub.hq_needs_llm_hint: High-quality translation fits each line to its segment time using a local or cloud LLM. Set one up to enable it.
dub.multi_lang_skipped: Translation failed for {{langs}} — those dubs were skipped so you never get a wrong-language track.
dub.paste_translation_desc: Paste a translation you produced elsewhere (ChatGPT, DeepL, a human translator). It maps onto the segments you already have — timings and the original transcript stay untouched.
dub.paste_translation_placeholder: Paste subtitles (SRT/VTT), numbered lines (1. …), or one translated line per segment — or drop a .srt/.vtt file here.
dub.paste_translation_none_matched: Nothing matched. Check that the pasted text lines up with the segments below.
dub.live_preview_title: Hear a line as you edit it — the edited segment streams TTS with its CAST voice after a short pause. Playback only: nothing is saved, and export still renders at full quality.
dub.live_preview_pick_voice: Assign a CAST voice to this line or its speaker to hear the live preview.
dub.agent_quality_desc: Translates in context, measures the real rendered speech, then rewrites only timing misses up to twice.
dub.agent_adapting: Adapting lines to their exact time...
dub.agent_cli_desc: {{agent}} translates every segment in context and rewrites timing misses after measured speech.
dub.no_local_agents: Install Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, or Pi to translate with a local agent.

dub_workflow.session_expired: This dub session expired or was cleaned up — re-upload your video to start a new one.
dub_workflow.import_srt_no_job: Upload or ingest a video first — there is no job to attach subtitles to.
dub_workflow.import_srt_after_speakers: SRT queued. Speaker analysis will finish first so cloned voices are preserved.
dub_workflow.cinematic_no_llm: This quality needs an LLM provider. Configure one in LLM Providers to continue.
dub_workflow.dialect_not_applied: The selected dialect needs an LLM to apply. Switch the translation engine to OpenAI/Ollama, or configure an LLM in Settings → Credentials → LLM endpoint.
dub_workflow.translate_degraded: All {{totalCount}} segment(s) translated — {{count}} used the plain translation because the polish pass was skipped ({{reason}})
dub_workflow.unsupported_translation_language: NLLB does not support: {{languages}}. Choose another language or translation engine.
dub_workflow.save_first: Please click 'Upload & Transcribe' first so the video is processed on the server before saving.
dub_workflow.delete_project_confirm: Delete this project? This cannot be undone.
dub_workflow.upgrading_preview: Upgrading {{count}} preview-quality segment(s) to full quality…

logs.no_tauri_log: No Tauri log on disk yet — launch via the desktop build to produce one
logs.empty_frontend: No frontend console entries captured yet. Interact with the app — every console.* will appear here.
logs.empty_tauri: No Tauri log available. Runs in the desktop shell only.
logs.empty_backend: Runtime log is empty. Activity will appear here as the backend logs it.
logs.title: Logs
logs.sponsors_aria: View sponsors and support the project
logs.report_copied: Diagnostic report copied — paste it into a GitHub issue.

settings.workers_desc: Send individual jobs to GPUs on your other machines. Results come back here. Nothing is sent until you add a worker and approve it.
settings.workers_enable_hint: While this is off, no connection is accepted and nothing leaves this machine.
settings.workers_port_conflict: Remote workers are unavailable because another VoiceStudio instance is already accepting them on this port. Close the other instance, or set OMNIVOICE_WORKER_PORT to a different port and restart VoiceStudio.
settings.workers_endpoint_hint: A worker has to be able to reach this address. On different networks, a VPN such as Tailscale is the reliable way.
settings.workers_add_hint: Generate a token, then paste it into OmniVoice on the other machine.
settings.workers_token_once: Copy this now — it is shown only once, works only once, and expires in 15 minutes.
settings.workers_none: No workers yet. Generate a token to add your first one.
settings.workers_remove_confirm: Remove {{name}}? Its key is revoked, so it cannot reconnect without a new token.
settings.inbound_revoke_confirm: Remove access for {{label}}? Their connection string stops working immediately. Everyone else stays connected.
settings.inbound_title: Share this GPU with other people
settings.inbound_desc: Let other machines connect to this one so several people can share its GPU. Every connection is encrypted and pinned to this machine’s certificate.
settings.inbound_enable_hint: Other people connect to this machine instead of it connecting to them. Nobody gets in without a connection string you create.
settings.inbound_bind_exposed: Anyone who can reach {{address}} can connect with a valid connection string. TLS encrypts the session and pins this machine’s certificate; keep each string private and remove access when it is no longer needed.
settings.inbound_bind_local: Only this machine can reach it. Enter your network address to let other machines connect.
settings.inbound_add_person_hint: Creates a connection string for one person. Give each person their own, so removing one does not disconnect everybody.
settings.inbound_shown_once: Copy this now — it is not shown again. Give it only to {{label}}.
settings.inbound_shown_once_warning: Treat it like a password and send it privately. Its certificate fingerprint pins the encrypted connection to this GPU machine.
settings.inbound_connect_desc: Paste the connection string someone gave you. The machine has to be accepting connections for this to work.
settings.inbound_connect_hint: Starts with ovnode:// and includes the key, address, port and certificate fingerprint.
settings.inbound_request_failed: Could not reach that GPU machine. Check that it is online and accepting connections, then try again.
settings.worker_join_code_hint: Single-use and expires in 15 minutes. Generate it on the machine that will send the work.
settings.worker_join_desc: Let another copy of VoiceStudio send jobs to this machine. Paste the join code it showed you — or scan its QR with your phone and paste it here.
settings.worker_join_env: OMNIVOICE_WORKER_MODE is set in this machine’s environment, so it decides — change it there.
settings.worker_join_ok: Joined. This machine is now taking work.
settings.workers_add_hint_qr: Generate a token, then scan the QR from the other machine or paste the code into its Remote workers settings.
settings.workers_qr_alt: QR code carrying this code — scan it from the other machine
settings.workers_step_1: Install VoiceStudio on the machine with the GPU.
settings.workers_step_3: Scan the QR there, or paste the code into its Remote workers settings.
settings.workers_token_qr_hint: On the other machine: Settings → System → Remote workers → Join, then scan or paste.
settings.usage_desc: What you have made with VoiceStudio — counted on your own machine.
settings.usage_privacy: These numbers are counted from your own history, on this machine, and are never sent anywhere. VoiceStudio has no analytics service — nothing here leaves your computer.
settings.usage_empty: You haven't generated anything yet — make something and it'll show up here.
settings.uninstall_desc: Delete everything VoiceStudio has written to this machine, then quit.
settings.uninstall_body: VoiceStudio is fully local, so uninstalling is just deleting the folders it wrote. This removes your voice profiles, projects, and generated audio permanently — there is no undo. Removing the app itself is a separate step.
settings.uninstall_target_models: Downloaded model weights (shared Hugging Face cache)
settings.uninstall_confirm_body: Your voice profiles, projects, and generated audio will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings.uninstall_partial: Some folders could not be removed: {{paths}}
settings.uninstall_models_caveat: The standard Hugging Face cache, shared with other AI tools on this machine — removing it may delete models VoiceStudio never downloaded. Anything VoiceStudio needs downloads again.
settings.uninstall_models_warning: This includes the shared Hugging Face cache ({{size}}) — models other AI tools downloaded may go with it.
settings.data_directory_desc: Move voices, projects, outputs and the app database to another drive.
settings.data_move_desc: VoiceStudio will verify the copy before switching folders. Keep the app open until it finishes.
settings.data_move_summary: {{size}} across {{count}} files. The original stays in place until the new copy is verified.
settings.data_move_old_copy: The new folder is active, but VoiceStudio could not remove the old copy. You can remove it manually.
settings.data_move_error: VoiceStudio could not move the data. The original folder is still active.
settings.data_move_error_target_not_empty: Choose an empty folder so existing files cannot be overwritten.
settings.data_move_error_nested_path: Choose a folder outside the current VoiceStudio data folder.
settings.data_move_error_insufficient_space: That drive does not have enough free space for the move.
settings.data_move_error_local_only: Data can be moved only for the local engine.
settings.data_move_error_backend_not_managed: Close the separately started backend, then let VoiceStudio start it before moving data.
settings.data_move_error_authorization_expired: That folder selection expired. Choose the folder again.
settings.data_move_error_backend_verification_fai: The new folder could not be activated. VoiceStudio restored the original folder.
settings.data_move_stage_restarting: Starting the local engine from the new folder…
settings.reset_desc: Put part — or all — of VoiceStudio back to how it shipped.
settings.reset_body_web: Clears locally-saved preferences (theme, language, dub settings) and reloads. Your voices, projects and generated audio are not affected.
settings.reset_tier_ui_hint: Theme, layout and dub knobs go back to defaults. Nothing on disk changes.
settings.reset_tier_settings_hint: Every preference, in the app and on disk. Your voices, projects and models are untouched.
settings.reset_tier_assets_hint: Model weights, sidecar engines, audio tools and caches. Everything you made stays. They re-download when next needed.
settings.reset_tier_everything_hint: Back to a fresh install: settings, voices, projects, audio, models, engines, logs. The app restarts on the first-run screen.
settings.reset_scope_ui_prefs: UI preferences — theme, language, layout, dub settings
settings.reset_scope_settings: App settings — engine choices, voice defaults, saved options
settings.reset_scope_history: Generation & dub history, with their audio
settings.reset_scope_content: Voices, projects, generated audio, and the app database
settings.reset_models_shared: Shared Hugging Face cache — may hold models other AI tools downloaded.
settings.reset_models_shared_warning: The model cache is the standard Hugging Face cache, shared with other AI tools on this machine — removing it may delete models VoiceStudio never downloaded. Everything VoiceStudio needs will download again on next use.
settings.reset_irreversible: Your voice profiles, projects and generated audio will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings.reset_restart_note: VoiceStudio will restart its engine to finish. This takes a few seconds.
settings.reset_partial: Some items could not be removed: {{paths}}
settings.clear_frontend_confirm: Clear the in-memory frontend log buffer?
settings.clear_backend_confirm: Clear the backend runtime + crash logs? This cannot be undone.
settings.llmp_desc: Powers Cinematic & Autofit translation — the LLM rewrites each line to fit its segment's time budget so the video timing holds. Keys are stored encrypted; local providers (Ollama/LM Studio) stay fully offline.
settings.llmp_catalogue_note: The provider marked active is what answers whenever the LLM engine family is set to OpenAI-compatible in the catalogue.
settings.llmp_catalogue_link: Open the LLM family in the catalogue
settings.llmp_provider_hint: Pick a provider to configure. The active one is used for Cinematic/Autofit translation. Local providers need no key but require their server to be running.
settings.llmp_key_env: set via environment (.env) — overrides this field
settings.llmp_saved_not_active: Saved — not yet used for translation. Click “Save & use for translation” to switch.
settings.llmp_err_config: Missing API key or Base URL — fill them in and save.
settings.llmp_err_auth: Key rejected (401/403) — check your API key.
settings.llmp_err_not_found: Not found (404) — check the model name and Base URL path.
settings.llmp_err_rate_limit: Rate-limited (429) — the key works; try again in a moment.
settings.llmp_err_network: Can't reach the provider — check the Base URL, your network, or that the local server is running.
settings.llmp_env_override: set via an environment variable — overrides this field
settings.llmp_active_env_pin: Active provider is pinned by the LLM_DEFAULT_PROVIDER environment variable.
settings.llmp_models_truncated: first {{count}} shown — type to narrow the model name
settings.llmskills_desc: Route each AI-powered feature to its own LLM — keep sensitive work on a local model (Ollama/LM Studio) while heavier jobs use a remote provider — or switch a feature off entirely. Off behaves exactly like having no LLM configured: the feature falls back to its non-LLM path.
settings.llmskills_dub_translation_desc: Translates dub lines directly with your configured LLM provider (the Dub tab's 'LLM' engine). Off: the LLM engine is unavailable — pick another engine.
settings.llmskills_cinematic_translation_desc: Rewrites each translated line for natural, in-character delivery (and Autofit's time budget). Off: dubs use the Fast translation result.
settings.llmskills_slot_fitting_desc: Trims or expands a translated line so its reading time fits the segment's time slot. Off: the line is used as-is.
settings.llmskills_glossary_extract_desc: Proposes project glossary terms (names, places, recurring terminology) from the source segments. Off: add glossary terms manually.
settings.llmskills_direction_parse_desc: Turns a natural-language delivery note ("more urgent, surprised") into structured voice-direction tokens. Off: a fast keyword heuristic is used instead.

crash.notice: The voice backend crashed ({{exit}}) {{ago}} ago and is being restarted automatically.
crash.details_intro: The backend process died unexpectedly ({{exit}}) {{ago}} ago. The error output it left behind is below — reporting it helps us fix the crash.
crash.notice_unclean: The previous session ended without a clean shutdown {{ago}} ago. This is often harmless — the machine slept, the app was force-quit, or a VM/container stopped.
crash.details_intro_unclean: The previous run's shutdown marker was never cleared, {{ago}} ago. VoiceStudio cannot tell whether it crashed or was simply interrupted — sleeping, force-quitting, or stopping a VM/container leaves the same trace. If everything works now, nothing needs doing.
crash.report_needs_log: No error output was captured for this event, so a one-click report would be empty. If something is actually wrong, please attach the last lines of Settings → Logs → Backend to a new issue.

errors.title: This tab hit a snag.
errors.desc: Don't worry — the rest of the app still works. You can switch tabs, or try again below.
errors.crash_port_in_use: The backend could not start because port 3900 is already in use — another copy of VoiceStudio (or an app that claimed that port) is holding it. Quit the other instance and relaunch; if nothing is visibly running, an orphaned backend from a previous session is still holding the port.
errors.crash_oom_kill: It was force-killed (signal 9), which usually means the operating system ran out of memory (RAM) and stopped it. Close memory-heavy apps, pick a smaller ASR model in Settings → Models, or flush the TTS model before transcribing.
errors.crash_native_fault: It crashed inside the compute stack rather than running out of memory — that points at a GPU driver that does not match the bundled CUDA runtime, or a model file that downloaded incompletely. Update your GPU driver, then re-download the model from Settings → Models (it repairs a partial download in place). If it keeps happening, switch to a crash-isolated engine in Settings → Engines — "VoiceStudio (subprocess)" for synthesis, "Faster-Whisper (crash-isolated subprocess)" for transcription. Those run the model in a separate process, so a crash like this takes down that process instead of the whole backend.
errors.report_failed: Couldn't open the bug report. Please try again, or copy the details above into a new issue.
errors.backend_shutting_down: VoiceStudio is shutting down. Reopen the app and try again.
errors.crash_broken_env: It died while loading its own Python dependencies, so this is not about memory or your GPU — the environment is incomplete or was left half-updated. Use "Clean & Retry" in Settings → Logs → Backend, which rebuilds it from scratch; that repairs it in place, without touching your voices or projects. If it still fails afterwards, the crash details name the exact package that would not import.
errors.crash_vram_default: On smaller GPUs the usual cause is running out of VRAM while loading the ASR model on top of the TTS model: flush the TTS model first, or pick a smaller ASR model in Model Catalogue → Models.
errors.stream_cut_backend_alive: The stream ended early, but the backend is still running — so it did not crash. In a served or containerised setup this is usually a reverse proxy or load balancer buffering or timing out the connection: disable response buffering for this route (nginx: proxy_buffering off; X-Accel-Buffering: no) and raise its read timeout. Running the desktop app directly, or on localhost without a proxy, will confirm it.

license.title: Supertonic-3 — License Acceptance
license.intro: Supertonic-3 ships under two distinct licenses. Please review both before enabling the engine.
license.sdk_desc: The Python inference SDK (supertonic) is MIT-licensed. Permissive use, including commercial.
license.model_desc: The Supertonic-3 model weights are released under the OpenRAIL-M license. This license restricts use to non-malicious purposes — see the linked license for the full set of use-based restrictions.
license.footer: Clicking Accept records your acceptance in VoiceStudio's local settings and enables the engine. Your acceptance is stored on this machine only — nothing is reported to Supertone Inc. or any third party.
license.pockettts_intro: PocketTTS (Kyutai) ships under two licenses. The weights are gated on HuggingFace, so please review both and note the access requirement.
license.pockettts_sdk_desc: The pocket-tts Python library is MIT-licensed. Permissive use, including commercial.
license.pockettts_model_desc: The PocketTTS model weights are released under CC-BY-4.0. Commercial use is permitted with attribution.
license.gate_desc: The weights are gated on Hugging Face. You need a free HF account, must share your contact information, and must accept the access conditions before the first download.
license.pockettts_conditions_desc: The access conditions prohibit illegal, harmful, deceptive, fraudulent, unauthorized, or non-consensual voice use. Review the full conditions before continuing.
license.pockettts_footer: Clicking Accept stores your acknowledgement only in VoiceStudio's local settings and enables the engine. Model access and downloads use Hugging Face, which receives the normal request and account information.

integrationCatalog.setupHint: Merge this configuration into {{file}}. Keep VoiceStudio running. Set any required remote credentials in your client.
integrationCatalog.title: Integrations
integrationCatalog.n8nHint: Import this workflow into n8n, edit the request, and run it. Keep VoiceStudio running. Docker and remote n8n need a reachable backend address and any required credentials.
integrationCatalog.externalHint: Opens the provider's website. VoiceStudio has no built-in setup for this entry.
integrationCatalog.setupUnavailable: Setup is unavailable for the current backend address. Check the backend URL in Settings.
integrationCatalog.mcpHttpHint: Point any Streamable HTTP MCP client at this URL. Send the {{header}} header to give the client its own voice.
integrationCatalog.mcpStdioHint: For stdio-only clients, run the bundled shim from a VoiceStudio source checkout. Replace cwd with your checkout path.
integrationCatalog.apiHint: OpenAI-compatible endpoints on this backend. Local requests need no key; remote requests need the backend's API key.
integrationCatalog.dockerHint: Pin :stable for releases; :latest is the rolling preview from main. Keep the generated API key: the app asks for it because Docker hides the loopback address.
integrationCatalog.apiBearerHint: This backend is remote: set OMNIVOICE_API_KEY in your shell to its API key. The snippets read it from there and never contain it.
integrationCatalog.apiInsecureHint: API keys need https:// on a remote backend. Put this backend behind https (for example Tailscale Serve) before using a key.
integrationCatalog.dockerGpuHint: GPU: NVIDIA needs --gpus all (in Compose, a GPU device reservation). AMD uses the :stable-rocm tag with /dev/kfd and /dev/dri. See the Docker install guide.
integrationCatalog.openaiAgentsHint: Point the OpenAI Agents SDK voice pipeline at VoiceStudio for speech-to-text and text-to-speech. Keep VoiceStudio running. For a remote backend, set OMNIVOICE_API_KEY before running. Set AGENT_LLM_BASE_URL and AGENT_LLM_MODEL to the language model server your agent should use.

calls.title: Calls
calls.history_empty: No calls yet. Your calls will show up here.
calls.no_call_body: Start a new call, or pick one from recent calls to see its transcript.
calls.number_hint: Include the country code, for example +1 for the US or +44 for the UK.
calls.number_missing_plus: Start with + and the country code, for example +1 555 010 0199.
calls.number_invalid: That doesn't look like a full international number (+, country code, then up to 14 digits).
calls.brief_placeholder: Book a table for 2 at 8pm on Friday under the name Sam. Any table is fine; ask for a window seat if they have one.
calls.example_restaurant_brief: Book a table for 2 people at 8pm this Friday under my name. If 8pm is full, anything between 7pm and 9pm is fine. Confirm the time and any deposit rules before hanging up.
calls.example_reschedule_brief: I have an appointment on Tuesday morning. Ask to move it to any weekday afternoon next week, confirm the new date and time, and ask if anything needs to be brought.
calls.example_hours_brief: Ask what their opening hours are this weekend and whether they take walk-ins.
calls.voice_none: No voice can place calls yet.
calls.voice_rule: Calls can use a voice you verified as your own, or a designed voice.
calls.disclosure_locked: Plays in full before the conversation starts; it can't be interrupted.
calls.disclosure_default: Hi, this is an AI assistant calling on behalf of my user. This call may be recorded.
calls.disclosure_off_warning: Some places require telling people they are speaking to an AI. Turn this off only if you are sure it is allowed.
calls.plan_empty: Describe the task above and the plan appears here.
calls.guard_disclosure: Opens with the disclosure line above.
calls.guard_payment: Won't share payment details, passwords or ID numbers.
calls.guard_ask: Asks you when it is unsure; you can take over at any time.
calls.guard_max: Hangs up after {{minutes}} min at most.
calls.blocked_setup: Finish the setup steps above to place calls.
calls.blocked_form: Add a valid number, a task and a voice to continue.
calls.confirm_body: VoiceStudio will call as {{voice}} and follow this task for up to {{minutes}} min. You can take over or hang up at any time.
calls.stream_lost: Live updates stopped. The call continues; reopen it to refresh.
calls.transcript_waiting: The transcript appears here once the call is answered.
calls.say_placeholder: Type what to say next, then press Enter
calls.summary_pending: The summary appears here when it is ready.
calls.ready_voice: A voice that may place calls
calls.unavailable_body: The backend you are connected to doesn't have the Calls feature yet, so nothing can be dialled from here.
calls.unavailable_step_update: Update VoiceStudio, or restart the backend after updating.
calls.unavailable_step_twilio: Connect a Twilio number so VoiceStudio can place calls.
calls.inbound_intro: Choose what happens when someone calls your Twilio number.
calls.inbound_greeting_desc: Play your greeting, then hang up.
calls.inbound_agent_desc: Talk with the caller in your voice, following the brief below.
calls.inbound_brief_placeholder: Take a message: ask for their name, number and what it is about.
calls.inbound_twilio_note: The number, credentials and greeting are set on the Twilio page.
